summary: Monarch's split mutation replaces every split line at once, so split writes stay dry-run by default, require the lines to equal an expected parent total, and re-read the transaction before writing.
reason: An off-by-a-cent file or a stale view of the transaction would overwrite real category data; the re-read refuses split lines, amount changes and existing splits unless --replace is passed. categories and transactions get exist to supply category IDs and a before snapshot for rollback.
validated_outcome: Two live splits applied and read back on a real account; dry-run makes no request and rejects totals off by one cent.
